info.name: PRISM — Estimates API
info.description:
Complete Estimates module: create, read, update, delete estimate with cost sheet line items.

**Setup:**
1. Set `baseUrl` variable to your server (e.g. http://localhost:3000)
2. Run the Login request first — it auto-saves the JWT token
3. All estimate requests use that token automatically

request.description:
Creates the estimate header + all cost sheet line items in a single atomic transaction.

The POST body auto-saves the returned `estimate.id` into the `{{estimateId}}` collection variable for subsequent requests.

item.name: 3. GET — Get Estimate by ID (with Line Items)

request.description: Returns the full estimate header + joined customer record + all line items ordered by lineNumber.

item.name: 4. PATCH — Update Header Fields Only (no line items change)

request.description: Only updates the fields you send. Omitting `lineItems` leaves the cost sheet completely unchanged.

request.description:
When `lineItems` is present in the PATCH body:
- All existing line items are DELETED
- The new array is inserted fresh with lineNumbers starting from 1
- The header fields are updated in the same transaction

This is the full 'Save' action when the user edits the entire form.

item.name: 6. PATCH — Clear All Line Items (send empty array)

request.description: Sending `lineItems: []` deletes all existing cost sheet rows. Header is unchanged.
Sets `is_active = false`. The estimate is not physically deleted and will no longer appear in list results.

request.description: Triggers server-side recalculation of: landedCostPerUnit, extendedLandedCost, salesAmount, skuMarginPct, cbmPerCarton, totalCartons, totalCbm, chargeableWeightKg
Sets `exclude = true` on the line item. Row remains in DB for audit purposes.
